front.title: The Vane Protocol for Feature Flag Rollouts

abstract.t: This document specifies Vane, the protocol between the SDKs that evaluate feature flags in applications and the Vane service that holds the flags. It defines the states of a flag, the messages of the update stream that keeps the cache of each SDK current, and the pause that protects users from a rollout that fails its checks.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: An application has many features, and each feature has a flag. An SDK in the application keeps the flags in a cache and evaluates them for each user. It holds an update stream open to the Vane service, which sends a message on it whenever a flag changes, and it asks the service for the status of a flag.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT", "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

dl.dd: A named switch in an application that turns a feature on for a share of its users.
The library in an application that evaluates flags from its cache and keeps the cache current with Vane messages.

A whole number from 0 to 100 that an owner gives to roll a flag out to that share of users. An SDK puts a user in the share by a hash of the flag and the user, so the user stays in it while the percentage grows.
A state in which a flag refuses every rollout for a time.

section.name: Flag States
section.t: A flag MUST be in exactly one of the states "stable", "rolling-out" and "paused".
A flag MUST start in the state "stable" when it is created.
A rolling-out flag SHOULD return to the state "stable" ten minutes after its rollout step began.

section.name: Messages
section.t: Each message is one line of ASCII text on the update stream: the service sends ROLLOUT and KILL, an SDK sends STATUS. The syntax uses ABNF .
section.sourcecode: message = rollout-update / kill-update / status-request rollout-update = "ROLLOUT" SP flag-key SP percentage CRLF kill-update = "KILL" SP flag-key CRLF status-request = "STATUS" SP flag-key CRLF flag-key = 1*32(ALPHA / DIGIT / "-") percentage = 1*3DIGIT

section.name: Rollout
section.t: A service MUST check the guardrail metrics of a flag before it applies the percentage of a rollout request.
A service MUST NOT roll out a flag while it is in a pause ().

section.name: Status
section.t: A service MUST answer a status request with the state of the flag and the number of failed checks since its last rollout step.

section.name: Pause
section.t: After five failed checks in a row, a service MUST put the flag in a pause.
A pause SHOULD last one minute. Should an owner be able to change the duration?

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: Vane messages travel in clear text on the network. Deployments SHOULD carry Vane over an encrypted link. This needs a requirement anchor of its own.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document has no IANA actions.
